name: molly-guide help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:molly-guide. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Close the walkthrough
entries.text: Closes the walkthrough. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Gizmo guide
entries.text: The Gizmo guide as a tab in a host app: the same walkthrough, docked beside the app's own tabs.

entries.title: What do you want to do
entries.text: Where you set “What do you want to do”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Stop talking
entries.text: Stops talking. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Show me the sample
entries.text: Turns “Show me the sample” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Read each step out loud
entries.text: Where you set “Read each step out loud”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Move the console to each step (run its action)
entries.text: Where you set “Move the console to each step (run its action)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Open walkthroughs asked for from AmberX by themselves
entries.text: Off by default: the guide then opens only when you ask in the console. On: a walkthrough you ask Gizmo for from AmberX opens here by itself (only ones made after the console loaded). Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Gizmo guide
entries.text: Shows the “Gizmo guide” part of this screen. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Ask Gizmo to show me
entries.text: Opens the guide window: ask Gizmo how to do something and he walks you through it, step by step. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Replay the last walkthrough
entries.text: Replays the last walkthrough. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Re-record the AmberX walkthrough
entries.text: Shows “Re-record the AmberX walkthrough”. Part of Gizmo guide.

entries.title: Gizmo guide
entries.text: Settings for Gizmo guide: narrated walkthroughs in a floating window, only when you ask. Choose whether each step is read out loud, whether the console moves to each step, and whether walkthroughs asked for from AmberX open by themselves.
